architectReview.evidence: Leader review of the run.rs refactor + mcp.rs additions. run.rs now extracts the per-test execute+analyze+fix+write_result loop into `run_collect(...) -> Vec<Value>` (no printing/exit) and `run(...)` (unchanged signature) delegates to it then prints/exits — so the CLI is behaviorally identical (spot-checked: `test run` human + `--json` output unchanged, 13/13 tests) and there is NO forked logic. mcp.rs adds two tools to tool_list() and two `call_tool` arms (testsprite_local_generate → local::generate::generate; testsprite_local_run → local::run::run_collect) returning `Ok(json!({...}))` exactly per the existing arms' `Result<Value>` convention (auto-wrapped by route()'s as_content). No slop, no duplication. The harness now drives the same local intelligence an IDE agent needs.

executorQa.evidence: Live end-to-end over stdio JSON-RPC (artifacts/mcp-harness-e2e.txt): after `initialize`, a `tools/call testsprite_local_run {id:m1}` against a scratch backend project returned `{content:[{type:text,text:'{results:[{id:m1,passed:true,title:root 200}]}'}]}` — the MCP harness executed a local test and returned the structured result inline. `tools/list` advertises 9 tools including testsprite_local_generate + testsprite_local_run. CLI unchanged (run delegates to run_collect); build clean, clippy 0, cargo test 13/13.
